goals.name: Build a camp
goals.description: The wind takes everything. Grow a windbreak, then light a fire in its shelter.

goals.name: Build a campfire
goals.description: Press Q and build a campfire from the reeds you carry.

goals.name: Catch a spark
goals.description: Hold the field recorder up to a lightning bug and collect its square wave.

goals.name: Build a heartbeat
goals.description: Patch both cables so the burbler sounds on every beat.

goals.name: Cut reeds
goals.description: Gather twelve reeds for a stream.

goals.name: Water the tree
goals.description: Lead the burbler's stream to a scrub oak.

goals.name: Stop the wind
goals.description: Keep the water flowing until the oak buds and breaks the wind.

goals.name: Light the fire
goals.description: Build a campfire near a running burbler, then strike it on the backbeat: 2 and 4.

goals.name: Clean the water
goals.description: Mud will not grow a grove. Build a check dam of reeds across the stream, tune it, and let clearer water reach an oak.

goals.name: Find a high-pass filter
goals.description: Openings in rock and hollow oak trunks pass short waves and stop long ones. Collect one with E (the scanner, B, shows them).

goals.name: Find an oscilloscope
goals.description: Still pools along a sounding stream ripple on the beat. Collect one with E.

goals.name: Craft a purifier kit
goals.description: At a lit campfire, press E and craft a reed water purifier: 20 reeds, the filter and the oscilloscope, with the clock between 96 and 144 BPM.

goals.name: Build a check dam
goals.description: Press Q and build the purifier across a laid stream.

goals.name: Leaf the oak
goals.description: Patch and tune the dam (E): low VCO to C2, high to C4, cutoff at C5. The water below clears to silty; lead it to an oak until it leafs.
